modal.title: Switch to {name}, the free option?
modal.lead: The free option costs the site nothing, but it is less reliable for rules questions. Here is the difference:
modal.c1: Reads the whole rulebook, including pages with diagrams
modal.c2: Cites the exact pages its answer comes from
modal.c3: Better at tricky edge cases and rule interactions
modal.f2: Only reads the rulebook's text (not images) and the pages that seem relevant
modal.f3: More likely to get a rule wrong or invent one — double-check in the rulebook
modal.f4: Questions go to an outside free service whose terms may allow using them to improve its models
modal.tip: Tip: for a quick reminder the free option is fine; for a rules dispute at the table, use Claude or check the rulebook.
